reason: The plugin primarily orchestrates agent responses by exposing a configurable StructuredOutput tool that validates outputs against user-supplied JSON Schemas.

summaries.zh: 为选定的 dsh 智能体模式提供可配置的结构化输出工具，并按受支持的 JSON Schema 子集校验结果。
summaries.en: Provides a configurable StructuredOutput tool for selected dsh agent modes and validates results against a supported JSON Schema subset.

capabilities: Registers a StructuredOutput tool for selected agent presets
Accepts object-rooted JSON Schemas through a /json-schema command
Validates agent tool outputs against the supported dsh JSON Schema subset
Installs or uninstalls the plugin by linking it into a dsh profile and updating bundle declarations
Builds the plugin with npm when the local toolchain is unavailable
